programs.name: defensive-ingestion-review
programs.source:
DEFINE SelectedAsset TEXTINPUT
HEADER 1 "GIS defensive-ingestion teaching example"
TYPEOUT "The project catalog describes ten synthetic GIS-K03 upload tests. The asset files remain local and are selected explicitly."

READ [Gis Defensive Ingestion Test Cases Form]
LIST case_id asset_file asset_kind expected_outcome

FREQ expected_outcome

SELECT expected_outcome = "accepted-review-axis-order" OR expected_outcome = "accepted-review-region"
LIST case_id asset_file expected_outcome review_reason
CANCEL SELECT

SELECT expected_outcome = "rejected-unsupported-media" OR expected_outcome = "rejected-malformed" OR expected_outcome = "rejected-coordinate-range" OR expected_outcome = "rejected-non-finite" OR expected_outcome = "rejected-feature-limit" OR expected_outcome = "rejected-nesting-limit" OR expected_outcome = "rejected-property-limit"
LIST case_id asset_file expected_outcome review_reason
CANCEL SELECT

DIALOG "Select a GeoJSON asset from the imported GIS defensive-ingestion example folder." SelectedAsset READ "*.geojson"
EPIAI GIS INSPECT FILE=SelectedAsset RESULT=GisInspection CRS=CRS84
DIALOG "Select a CSV asset from the imported GIS defensive-ingestion example folder." SelectedAsset READ "*.csv"
EPIAI GIS INSPECT FILE=SelectedAsset RESULT=GisCsvRejection CRS=CRS84
TYPEOUT "GIS INSPECT displays the bounded Worker receipt and diagnostics in Output."
programs.author: Epi Info AI
programs.comment: Loads the test-case catalog, filters the expected outcomes, and prompts the learner to select each uploadable asset for the GIS-K03 inspection spike.

runbooks.title: GIS defensive-ingestion review
runbooks.description: Use the imported test catalog and the uploadable assets to review automatic GIS-K03 rejection versus cases requiring human axis or study-area review.
runbooks.prerequisite: Import the GIS Defensive Ingestion Teaching example project from File > Import Example Project. Keep the adjacent gis-defensive-ingestion asset folder available for explicit upload.

steps.title: Open the saved teaching program
steps.instruction: Open Program Editor and select GIS defensive-ingestion review.

steps.title: Load the test-case catalog
steps.instruction: Run the program through the READ and LIST commands to review all ten synthetic test cases.

steps.title: Review filter groups
steps.instruction: Run the selected commands for review-required coordinates and automatic rejection cases. Do not treat valid numeric ranges as proof of axis or sign correctness.

steps.title: Inspect uploadable assets
steps.instruction: Open the GIS-K02/K03 inspection page and select the listed GeoJSON or CSV asset. Compare the observed result with expected_outcome.
